# wallet address

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:walletAddress`](gmeow-walletAddress.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/walletAddress>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)

A public address of the crypto wallet. Non-functional: a single wallet may have multiple addresses (e.g. HD wallet derivation paths).
